musicDeclaration.description: The media registry's `music` entry: exactly one of a supplied track or a synthesized-score declaration.

policyDeclaration.description: The media registry's optional `audio` record. The older `mix` record (musicVolume, ducking) remains valid and is read with lower precedence; a declaration in `audio` wins over the same key in `mix`.

ducking.description: Sidechain parameters keyed on the narration stem. Explicit null declares no ducking. When the key is absent entirely and narration and music coexist in own mode, the policy default applies.

loudnessTarget.description: Own mode only; in own mode a target always applies (this declaration sets its values, absence selects the policy default -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP).

mode.description: Advisory only: if it contradicts the mode resolved from the compiled timeline's audio_owner, resolution fails with ASSEMBLE_AUDIO_MODE_VIOLATION. The compiled plan is authoritative.

resolvedAudioPlan.description: Written by scripts/audio_policy.py:resolve_audio_plan, carried on the assembled job, and copied into the assemble probe record. This, not the registry, is what assembly consumes.

loudnessTarget.description: Non-null only in own mode with at least one audio source: the modes with an independent final mix are the only ones a loudness target applies to.

path.description: Registry-relative for a supplied track; filled with the absolute produced path for a synthesized score once resolution executes it.

description: Two records: the policy declaration a job's media registry may carry (the registry's `audio` record), and the resolved audio plan the policy layer produces exactly once and the assembler consumes. Resolution rules live in references/audio-policy.md; the resolver is scripts/audio_policy.py.
